items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And on my record that I make for Columbia, there was ... Wendell Marshall

ctx.x: Doug Watkins. He had a good sound and a good feeling. And Art Taylor and Hank Jones. And on my record that I make for Columbia, there was [Bobi?] [makes sounds], small group type thing, with Ray Brian, Wendell Marshall, who used to play with Duke Ellington and Billy Hart, the drummer.
Did you have an agent or management to handle all these…?
